title: Refutation of the Nielsen Ioana+Θ Reductio (v0.1.1-report)
description:
Bounded public report (v0.1.1). Refutation of J. L. Nielsen's application of Ioana's Theorem 8.2 (JAMS 2011) to the twisted comultiplication Θ(f u_g)=f u_g ⊗ Φ(u_g). By construction im(Θ) ⊆ A_G ⊗̄ L(H), so Ioana hypothesis (2) fails and the reductio does not obtain rigid-case group morphisms from that application.

Not asserted: Connes rigidity true or false; validity of OpenAI or Zhou counterexamples; full formalization of Ioana (2011).

Companion Lean package: Quantyra/connes-rigidity-lean tag v0.1.1-obstruction. Quantyra-authored report text CC-BY-4.0; third-party source PDFs in docs/sources/ remain under their original rights and are pins only.
